description: React component for an asynchronous dropdown menu with dynamic data fetching, credential integration, and customizable options, used within a UI package of a larger project.

methods.name: fetchList
methods.description: Fetches a list of nodes or options from the server based on node data and parameters.

methods.name: fetchCredentialList
methods.description: Retrieves credential options based on provided credential names.

methods.name: getDefaultOptionValue
methods.description: Returns default value for the dropdown based on whether multiple selection is enabled.

methods.name: findMatchingOptions
methods.description: Finds options matching the current internal value, supporting multiple selection.

methods.name: addNewOption
methods.description: Defines an option to create a new item.
